text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I bring <chrname>
to the
infirmary for a checkup.
Oh! A custo―I mean, a student! Hello!

Are you hurt? Sick? Stressed? Whatever
it is, I
treat it all!

Well, considering you're at the academy

infirmary, I'd say that makes me your
trusty
school nurse! Yup, just your
average school
employee!

Ahaha! Guess there's no fooling you. I
suppose I
should start by giving you my
name.
Ahem! Allow me to introduce myself!

I am the (likely) savior of all
Umamusume, the
(self-proclaimed)
legendary acupuncturist with
the magic
touch...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
The one and only Sasami Anshinzawa!
See? No
worries! ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That doesn't tell us anything! Don't think
I'm just
gonna let any ol' weirdo on
campus without
repercussions!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Gosh! You sure seem worried! ☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
No matter! No matter! We've made our

introductions, so lie down and let me
put these
needles to work!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hands off! If you're lookin' for a
one-on-one, then
let's duke it out with
our fists!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! No need to be scared! All I'm
going to do
is slip these extraordinary
needles precisely into
your chakra
points.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Then voilà, presto! Something
indescribable will
happen!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
And let me assure you, there's
absolutely nothing
sketchy about this at
all! It's never gone anything
less than
perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: ...For my master.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Don't fret! This is my first time, so
technically, I've
never failed a patient
either!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
And it's not like I have no experience! I
spent ten
years under a legendary
master, fetching dri—I
mean, training!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: See? No worries! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's no way we're doing this. I take

<chrname> and head for the
door,
when...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: W-wait! Where are you going?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
You're Hishi Amazon, right?! Leader of
Miho
Dorm and the fearless Queen of
the Amazons who
won't back down from
any fight, no matter how
strong the
opponent?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Have I heard of her? Of course I have!
I'm a big
fan!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
That's precisely why I'm here! To give
you my
support! Let me help you!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Just give me a chance! Pleeease!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
On second thought, she seems all right.
Maybe I
judged her too quickly...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Please! Pretty please with a carrot on
top! I'll even
let you choose which
chakra I activate!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: I'm sure I won't mess up!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Well... pretty sure.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: I mean, it's on the sure side! That's good, right? Anyway, don't get hung up on the details!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Let's get to the good stuff! Which chakra should I activate? Do you want a boost to your abilities? Your health? Or maybe your charm?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I smell danger in the air, but I figure there might—and I emphasize might—be a chance of getting something special out of this treatment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What should we do?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see. So you want me to activate
the
strength chakra?
choice_data_list: 強いウマ娘になれる秘孔を狙う
レースで勝てる秘孔を狙う
元気で健康になれる秘孔を狙う
魅力アップの秘孔を狙う
不安なのでやめておく

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Then let's get started! Are you ready?
There's no
going back after!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
All right, leave it to me! Time to locate
that
chakra! Ollie, ollie, oxen free!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Now, just relaaax... See? No worries! ☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Aaand poke!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Urk!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Puncture Perfect!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What is this feeling? My body's heatin'
up!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna go for a run, Teach! I feel like
I'm about
to burst with energy!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Gasp... You're kidding... It actually worked?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
No waaay! I can't believe it! I'm a total
genius!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> is overflowing
with so
much power she's almost
unrecognizable!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We took a chance and it paid off! This is
a great
leap toward achieving our goal!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... The heck's... happening? Feels
like the
energy got zapped outta my
body...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Ngh... This is so pathetic of me...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
<chrname>'s condition
deteriorates
rapidly.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: So... That's that, I guess...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Well, would you look at the time? I
should get
going! Bye! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I should've known better than to test our
luck. I'm
not the one suffering, yet I'm
full of regret.

text_block_list.text: Aw, c'mon! Don't be like that!

text_block_list.text: Hey! You there! I hope you know trespassers will be prosecuted!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Gah! I've been found out!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Welp, I'm outta here! ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: So she was just a weirdo who wandered on to campus! Man, if I see her again, I'm gonna send her packin'!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'm not gonna let her near any other students as long as I'm alive and kickin'!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm curious who this Anshinzawa
character really
is, but there's no use
ruminating over it. Best to
forget about
today and move on.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Had a change of heart, did you? No
worries, it
happens!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:

want me
to activate, then!

second... How long have I been here?

<chrname>
and I look at
